videos.titulo: Camping trip 🏕️ Smooth Jazzy Chillhop for Study & Relax | Animal Crossing Ambience
videos.descripcion:
On a weekend when the fall air starts to feel just right,
I pack a few things and head out for a little camping trip nearby.
As I slowly set up the tent and make something warm to eat,
the rush of everyday life seems to fade away for a while.

Once the sun goes down, I sit by the campfire,
and somehow even the crackling fire and chilly air feel comforting.
After spending some time just like that, I head home,
thinking maybe it’s the simple days like this that stay with us the longest.
__________

videos.titulo: Fall Diary 🌰 Relaxing Jazzy Chillhop for Study & Relax | Animal Crossing Ambience
videos.descripcion:
The sky had been clear since morning,
so after lunch, I slowly made my way outside and found a spot to settle in.
I laid out some snacks and tea,
then opened the book I’d been saving for a quiet afternoon like this.

With the wheat swaying gently in the breeze,
I could really feel autumn in the air.

It was getting close to dinnertime,
but I wanted to take in a little more of this cozy afternoon,
so I stayed right there until the sunset spread a little further across the sky.
___________________
